label: Fuse Beads
blurb: Rebuilds the picture from little plastic fuse beads set on a pegboard: each bead takes the nearest colour in a craft bead box, or the picture's own colour, and is a hollow tube with a glossy rim and a hole through the middle. Ironed sets how far the iron has been over them, from loose round beads with the board showing between them to beads melted flat and fused into each other with the holes closing up, and every bead melts and sits a little differently.
